[EN] You can remove the barrier by defeating all the Divine Guardians in the nearby ruins.
[ES] Puedes eliminar la barrera derrotando a todos los Divine Guardians en las ruinas cercanas.

[EN] You take care of the two in the right.
I will take care of the rest.
[ES] Tú encárgate de los dos de la derecha.
Yo me encargaré del resto.
